title: The Dark Side of Our Brains: Can We Trust Our Senses?
topic: Disturbing human brain glitches and illusions science cannot explain
script: Imagine waking up every morning with a sense of certainty, only to discover that your entire reality has been a lie. Our brains are wired with disturbing glitches that blur the lines between reality and illusion. Think you know what's real? Think again. Every decision, every action, every perception - all just a product of a sickly complex computer program. You're trapped in a never-ending loop of neurosis. Can we ever truly know what's real? Is our reality just a never-ending simulation? The question lingers: are we just rats in a maze, or is the maze just a product of our own minds?
